title: siRNA Electroporation of Hydra
author: Adrienne Cho
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6t2heqe

steps.title: Wash and Incubate Animals
steps.instruction: Wash animals (fed one day earlier) 5 times with Milli-Q water and incubate for 45 minutes at 18°C.

steps.title: Prepare Animals in Cuvette
steps.instruction: Place 20 animals into an electroporation cuvette with a 0.4cm gap and remove as much liquid as possible.

steps.title: Add siRNA Solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL sterilized 10mM HEPES (pH7.0) containing 4µM siRNA to the cuvette.

steps.title: Distribute and Relax Animals
steps.instruction: Tap the cuvette 10 times to evenly distribute the animals, then let them relax and extend for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Configure Electroporation System
steps.instruction: Set the Biorad GenePulser Xcell electroporation system to the following parameters: Voltage: 150 V, Length: 50 ms, Number of Pulses: 2, and Pulse Intervals: 0.1 s.

steps.title: Electroporate and Add Medium
steps.instruction: Electroporate the animals. Immediately after administering each pulse, add 500 µL 18°C restoration medium.

steps.title: Transfer Animals
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer animals to a dish filled with restoration medium.

steps.title: Recover Animals
steps.instruction: Allow animals to recover in the restoration medium for 48 hours.

steps.title: Repeat Procedure
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire process (Steps 1-8) two additional times.
